628: Exhibition at the pump track opening in Čáslav
629: This time the weather was kind, and the team of Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, Michal Budský and Márty Kabeláč could fire off ...
630: Probably the last outdoor exhibition of the year is history. This time the weather was kind, and the team of Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, Michal Budský and Márty Kabeláč could fire off exhibition tricks in front of the town leadership on the asphalt surface near the pump track.
631: The pump track itself was created by digging out soil for a pond by the cycle path and is made of earth with fine gravel on the surface. Thanks to its proximity to the cycle path and the National Agricultural Museum, there will be no shortage of visitors. Besides our team, the guys from BMX Pardubice came to test it, and after the show Michal and Márty joined them and tested it like their lives depended on it.
632: The event organisers are also talented photographers, so this time we have exceptionally great photos from the event.
634: Exhibitions in Zdechovice and Stráž near Tachov
635: This Saturday we didn't ride a record number of exhibitions, but we equalled our record for the number of riders from our team plus guests.
636: Stráž near Tachov, where the town festival was held, was covered by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and Mára Tryner. The festival was relatively small, but with an interesting programme featuring a group of gunners with cannons. You don't want to hear that roar and feel the pressure wave from the cannonade :) The guys were accompanied by our smallest rider, Marty Kabeláč.
637: A noticeably bigger event was the Zdechovice festival, where Martin Šimůnek, Lukáš Valný and Matouš Balík went for Trial, together with Dalibor Šulc for moto-trial and, as if that weren't enough, parkour athlete Marek from Artmoving. In 3 shows and workshops the guys entertained the large audience of the Zdechovice festival.
638: And finally, a thank you and a bit of showing off of a new addition to the team garage. Besides a new Crewkerz Trial bike, Vlasta has finally renewed his full-suspension bike after more than 6–7 years. A CUBE frame thanks to our cooperation with the brand of the same name, and complete components from the range of our partner Levelsportkoncept. On the bike you'll find exclusive products from E-thirteen, Spank and DVO suspension. The wheel size changed too, from 27.5” to 29”. Marek Tryner, by contrast, updated his TREK Remedy to the 2022 version. Martin Šimůnek brought the same bike plus a CUBE e-bike.

645: Last weekend we had the chance to test components from our partner Levelsportkoncept.cz – their products are also in our shop {1}www.bikeskills.cz/shop{2} .
646: Luxurious suspension, pedals and cockpit, on both 27.5" and 29" bikes. We still film videos as amateurs, and the guys filming us had very shaky hands (probably from excitement about the bikes, or something .)), but anyway we enjoyed the ride and let the bikes have a drink of mud.
647: Besides team riders Mára Tryner, Lukáš Valný (at the time with a dislocated shoulder) and Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, guys from our {1}www.mtbtrial.cz club{2} joined in too (the Koudelák brothers, Martin Dostál, Matouš Balík).
648: {1}Thanks for the loan, {2}www.levelsportkoncept.cz{3} – hopefully next time in a slightly more professional mode. (I'm saving up for a phone with stabilisation.)
649: Veteran vehicle meet in Horní Police and town festival in Staré Křečany
650: This Saturday a slightly more demanding weekend awaited us. Martin Šimůnek, Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and Matouš Balík headed north for a double exhibition in Horní Police, which was unusually located between the historic and the new bridge. Spectators could watch the action from the tents in front of the stage as well as from the pedestrian zone and the pavements on the bridges. The slightly complicated surface didn't faze the guys, and the exhibitions drew a large crowd.
651: In the break between shows the guys went to test a nearby bike park that could be a venue for Bikeskills.cz coaching courses. After returning and riding the second exhibition they set off for Staré Křečany, which is just a stone's throw from the German border.
652: The festival in Křečany was in grand style. Concerts, security, a precisely set schedule. Our job was to fill the slot before one of the main bands. We rode just about everything we could fit in, including bigger jumps on the trailer and a Šluknov sandwich over volunteers :)
653: Ball Lightning 2 – Čáslav, Bratronice, Choteč, Suchdol, Bojkovice
654: Sunday was literally like the famous Czech film Ball Lightning. 3 teams, 5 locations, 6 shows and two stops swapping riders. An incredible onslaught, where one or two mishaps would have made everything collapse like a house of cards.
655: In the morning our host dropped out because of a voice problem, so Vlasta had to host the exhibition at Great-Grandpa's Tractor, contrary to plan. Every cloud has a silver lining, and thanks to little Márty, whom he took along, the exhibition was ridden with 3 riders straight away. From Čáslav we went to Bratronice near Kladno, where Martin Šimůnek with Vlasta and Petr Jeřicha – who almost didn't make it because his car broke down – ran a workshop and an exhibition. The Kabeláč sisters helped too, joining in the riding.
656: In the end the Čáslav squad also arrived in Bratronice, the riders were reshuffled, and Lukáš Valný, Vlasta, the girls and Tobík Dolák set off for a children's day in Choteč. Martin Šimůnek and Matouš, on the other hand, went to Suchdol for the local sports festival. Petr Jeřicha took his car to be serviced, and meanwhile in Moravia Mára Tryner and Michal Budský were warming up at Slavex bike park before the exhibition in Bojkovice.
657: Beautiful weather and great turnouts at all events were refreshing and motivating for us. Vlasta and Tobík even managed a short training session in the forest afterwards. Next weekend we continue at a slightly more relaxed pace. Thanks to all the organisers for the invitations and to the riders for their performances. We have a video from Mára and Michal in the article :)
658: Women Tune Up with Bikeskills camp no. 3 and the Ledenice potato pancake festival exhibition
659: Organising a women's camp and an exhibition in Ledenice on the same day was a bit of a challenge for us, mainly because of a lot of illness and the absence of guys from the club. In the end we managed to put together a team for both events. This time the camp was led by Mára Tryner, Katarína Tóthová and Matouš Balík, assisted in the morning by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček.
660: Around noon, though, Vlasta and Lukáš Valný headed for Ledenice, where the local association's traditional event with a potato pancake cooking contest was taking place. The exhibition in two shows on the square in beautiful weather was great, thanks also to the turnout and the cheering.
661: On the other side of the country, women and girls had the chance to take their skills to the next level and, under the guidance of Mára and Katarína, try out what they can do.
662: And as if that weren't enough, a recording from Říčanské Šlapačky 2021 was on TV – thanks to the Lvíčata team :) From 18:00: https://decko.ceskatelevize.cz/lvicata
664: The atmosphere was relaxed and the participants showed a great desire to improve. For basic technique we didn't worry about who had which bike, and since a few couples signed up too, after agreeing with the riders we combined everything into one day.. As at the first camp, everything here revolved around the bikes and the riders' individual abilities. The goal was to pass on as many skills as possible and help everyone overcome their fear – the progress by the end of the camp was more than visible and everyone deserves praise. Riding and fun were taken care of by Katarína Tóthová and Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček.
665: Elektrobikefestival and an exhibition for the Prague Municipal Police
666: Over the weekend we organised the first edition of elektrobikefestival.cz in Říčany. Two days of e-bike testing, exhibitions, a raffle and interesting talks looked grim because of the weather, but after the Saturday morning rain, e-bike enthusiasts started arriving in the afternoon. On Sunday it was full on in beautiful sunny weather. Ivan Mejstský took care of the right atmosphere. The exhibitions were provided by our Trialshow.cz team under the supervision of the festival's father, Pavel Hájek. Besides the kid riders, Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, Lukáš Valný, Tobík Dolák and, on Sunday, Martin Šimůnek performed, and other team members came along outside the shows too.
667: On Saturday there were also several exhibitions for the Prague Municipal Police, led by Mára Tryner and Michal Budský.
669: Anyone who has ever experienced an injury, instability or another problem has surely come across Kine-MAX tapes. But the manufacturer doesn't live on tapes alone – the brand's portfolio also includes many other products: balance pads and balls, skipping ropes, massage rollers and balls, and resistance bands.
670: Every biker who goes all in will surely use some of these products, which we use ourselves, and we hope they'll help you progress in what you're doing or prevent injury.

683: Once again the camp is for all bikers, riders and guys on bikes who can take a bit of advice and like learning new things. From the perspective of riders and racers, we'll teach you what and how to train and what to focus on. Pump track, trails, berms, corners, brake control, balance, and also awareness of the bike itself in the form of a short workshop. For the braver ones there are smaller benches, mini doubles, small drops and semi-legal trails in the area.
685: The Tehov leisure park and its surroundings are a great place to learn something. In cooperation with the municipality of Tehov, the local park was built and developed for leisure activities, including cycling. There are also plenty of trails nearby for technique coaching
686: On the pump track you'll practise pumping, flow and a few jumps for those who fancy it. We can practise riding without pedalling, riding rhythm, pedal position in corners, or riding properly fast.
687: There's also a Skills centre – in other words, what to avoid and what to try riding over on a ride. Maybe even get into the basics of Trial a little.
